documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Sportking India reported a strong start to FY27, driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement. Management highlighted successful commercial operations of their solar power project and progress on their 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion in Odisha, with Phase 1 expected to commence production in the third quarter. The company remains optimistic about medium to long-term industry outlook, aided by structural shifts in global sourcing, favorable trade agreements, and improved export demand, particularly from China and Bangladesh. Additionally, the company is progressing on downstream acquisitions to expand into fabrics and garments. Sportking India Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting a revenue from operations of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue of around 3,000 crores for the current financial year and more than 4,000 crores next year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores. So that's what 20% up. And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters due to higher prices.
guidance.quote: So we expect top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters because of the higher prices.

guidance.claim: Management expects margins to expand quarterly by at least 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: We don't -- they'll be -- they shall be -- we are looking at quarter-on-quarter expanding by at least 15%, 20%.

guidance.claim: Management expects both acquired companies to grow by 15% to 20% at least in FY27.
guidance.quote: FY27 now, we expect both the companies to grow by 15% to 20% at least.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, and management is encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: On the domestic front, demand is expected to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Most of the incremental demand for yarn export into India has come from China.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted improved demand in almost all geographies across the world and segments.
demand_outlook.quote: First of all, the improved demand in almost all the geographies across the world and in all the segments that we meet.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton spreads have reached almost 3-year highs and are expanding.
demand_outlook.quote: Cotton spreads have reached almost 3- year highs and are expanding.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton yarn spread is around more than $1 between the skein cost and final yarn prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Cotton yarn spread today is, I think, around more than $1 between the skein cost and the final yarn prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Local demand is leading the charge since March when the U.S. tariff went away.
demand_outlook.quote: Local demand though lagging for first few months is now leading the charge since March when the U.S. tariff went away.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned with construction activities underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The 40-megawatt solar power supply will commence by the end of May and is expected to save INR14 crores to INR15 crores annually.
capex_expansion.quote: The 40-megawatt solar power supply will commence by the end of May and is expected to save around INR14 crores to INR15 crores next year, this -- annually.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is progressing on a greenfield expansion project of approximately INR1,000 crores to enhance spindle capacity by around 150,000 spindles.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also making strong progress on our greenfield expansion project of approximately INR1,000 crores, which will enhance our spindle capacity by around 150,000 spindles.

capex_expansion.claim: For the greenfield project, land acquisition is complete, machinery advances released, and commercial operations are expected to commence in the third quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: The land acquisition has been completed, advances of machinery have been released and the construction activities are progressing as scheduled. This expansion will significantly strengthen our production capabilities, improve operational efficiency and position us to effectively cater to the growing demand. We expect the commercial operations of the project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved acquiring a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our strategic growth plan, the Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, which will strengthen our processing capabilities and enhance our integrated operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved acquiring the manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on a lease basis.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has also approved the acquisition of the manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis subject to definitive agreement and customary approvals.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant has embedded incentives and is expected to yield EBITDA margins 300 to 400 basis points or more higher than old plants.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

margins_costs.claim: The annual cost savings from the solar park are expected to be around 15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved during the quarter supported by better yarn realization and better cotton demand.
margins_costs.quote: Our revenue broadly remained stable while profitability improved. This growth was supported by better yarn realization and better demand for cotton yarn during the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects to expand margins for the next 2 to 3 quarters with increasing spreads and good cotton coverage.
margins_costs.quote: We are expecting to expand our margins for next 2, 3 quarters with these increasing spreads and a good cotton coverage.

margins_costs.claim: The 40-megawatt solar project will save around INR15 crores a year.
margins_costs.quote: We'll be saving around, I think, INR2 per unit -- around -- about INR15 crores a year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is already operating at optimum capacity of 95%, 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Volume-wise, we don't see any increase in volume because we are already working at full capacity, whatever is optimum capacity, 95%, 96%.

orders_capacity.claim: The greenfield spindle capacity of 150,000 will take 6 months from commissioning to achieve 97%, 98% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: I think the day we start commissioning, it should take 6 months from there where we can fully - - when we can expect 97%, 98% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: Advances for machinery have been released for the greenfield expansion project.
capital_allocation.quote: The land acquisition has been completed, advances of machinery have been released and the construction activities are progressing as scheduled.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

risks_headwinds.claim: The macro climate is still of huge uncertainty because of multiple wars going on.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though there are some headwinds as well, the macro climate is still of huge uncertainty because of multiple wars going on.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inflation forecasts point to higher inflation which generally does not bode well for growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Inflation forecasts are of higher inflation, which generally doesn't bode well for growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Duty on cotton continues to be a detriment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Duty on cotton, though right now not that relevant, continues to be a detriment.

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production at the Odisha greenfield project is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to ramp up the Odisha plant fully in about 5 to 6 months, reaching about 90% capacity utilization by March end.
management_commitments.quote: So it will take us around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up. And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial operations of the greenfield project are expected to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the commercial operations of the project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects both acquired companies to grow by 15% to 20% at least in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 now, we expect both the companies to grow by 15% to 20% at least.

management_commitments.claim: The 40-megawatt solar power supply will commence by the end of May.
management_commitments.quote: The 40-megawatt solar power supply will commence by the end of May and is expected to save around INR14 crores to INR15 crores next year, this -- annually.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
